arms.name: clock
arms.description: the wall clock was frozen at a different date each run

flakes.evidence: stable under identical repetition; failed 52 of 120 runs when the wall clock was frozen at a different date each run
flakes.suggested_fix: it reads the wall clock; freeze or inject the time

flakes.evidence: stable under identical repetition; failed 63 of 120 runs when PYTHONHASHSEED varied
flakes.suggested_fix: something iterates a dict or set and depends on the order; sort it

flakes.evidence: flipped with nothing changed: failed 64 of 120 identical runs
flakes.suggested_fix: it flips with nothing changed - unseeded randomness, a race, or state left behind by an earlier run (a cache, a file outside tmp_path, a database row). If it failed once and then never again, look for the state first
